result_evidence: results.stderr contains exact normal unittest lines; multiline descriptions and doctests are joined into the canonical one-line ID format. result_raw_lines maps each result to its raw stderr line. Large stderr files are excerpted; original raw hashes and sizes are retained.
source_withdrawal: Not performed: the replay removed its positive images, and rebuilding and rerunning full suites was outside the conservative finish instruction.
native_execution: Native observations came from the pinned Imre-built image. No stock CPython was used to execute a native launcher; native child interpreter selection was IMRE_PYTHON where configured.
